question: How should one select a corpse after considering the eightfold list?
premises: An eightfold set has been described
That eightfold set is to be abandoned
Any one of the previously mentioned corpses may be chosen
inference: After setting aside the eightfold category, one should select any one of the previously mentioned corpses.
uncertainties: Exact scope of the eightfold set being excluded
plain_english: Thus, having abandoned the eightfold kind, one should take any one of the previously mentioned corpses.
